name: homban2
description: Homban - Go API + React frontend behind a local HTTPS reverse proxy

scripts.build: npm --workspace frontend run build && npm run build:backend
scripts.check: npm --workspace frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace proxy run typecheck && go -C backend vet ./...
scripts.certs:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for (const f of fs.readdirSync('proxy/certs')) if (/[.](crt|key)$/.test(f)) fs.rmSync('proxy/certs/'+f)"
